title: The How the Chorus Decides the Key
youtube_title: The How the Chorus Decides the Key | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Listening all the way through is a gift you can give today.
summary: At a kitchen table before breakfast, chairs close, Mama begins to tell Ilaria about how the chorus decides the key. Ilaria wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
